mn100:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ.
mn100:2.1: tena kho pana samayena dhanañjānī nāma brāhmaṇī maṇḍalakappe paṭivasati abhippasannā buddhe ca dhamme ca saṅghe ca.
mn100:2.2: atha kho dhanañjānī brāhmaṇī upakkhalitvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
mn100:3.1: tena kho pana samayena saṅgāravo nāma māṇavo maṇḍalakappe paṭivasati tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.
mn100:3.2: assosi kho saṅgāravo māṇavo dhanañjāniyā brāhmaṇiyā evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsamānāya,
mn100:3.4: avabhūtāva ayaṃ dhanañjānī brāhmaṇī, paribhūtāva ayaṃ dhanañjānī brāhmaṇī vijjamānānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ. atha ca pana tassa muṇḍakassa samaṇakassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsatīti.
mn100:3.5: na hi pana tvaṃ tāta bhadramukha, tassa bhagavato sīlapaññāṇaṃ jānāsi.
mn100:3.6: sace tvaṃ tāta bhadramukha, tassa bhagavato sīlapaññāṇaṃ jāneyyāsi, na tvaṃ tāta bhadramukha, taṃ bhagavantaṃ akkositabbaṃ paribhāsitabbaṃ maññeyyāsīti.
mn100:3.7: tena hi bhoti, yadā samaṇo gotamo maṇḍalakappaṃ anuppatto hoti. atha me āroceyyāsīti.
mn100:3.8: evaṃ bhadramukhāti kho dhanañjānī brāhmaṇī saṅgāravassa māṇavassa paccassosi.
mn100:4.1: atha kho bhagavā kosalesu anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno, yena maṇḍalakappaṃ tadavasari.
mn100:4.2: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā maṇḍalakappe viharati todeyyānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ ambavane.
mn100:5.1: assosi kho dhanañjānī brāhmaṇī. ‘bhagavā kira maṇḍalakappaṃ anuppatto maṇḍalakappe viharati todeyyānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ ambavane’ti.
mn100:5.2: atha kho dhanañjānī brāhmaṇī yena saṅgāravo māṇavo, tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā saṅgāravaṃ māṇavaṃ etadavoca:
mn100:5.3: ‘ayaṃ tāta bhadramukha, so bhagavā maṇḍalakappaṃ anuppatto, maṇḍalakappe viharati todeyyānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ ambavane.
mn100:5.4: yassadāni tvaṃ tāta bhadramukha, kālaṃ maññasīti.
mn100:5.5: ‘evaṃ bhotī’ti kho saṅgāravo māṇavo dhanañjāniyā brāhmaṇiyā paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
mn100:5.6: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho saṅgāravo māṇavo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn100:6.1: ‘santi kho bho gotama, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā diṭṭhadhammābhiññāvosānapāramippattā ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānanti.
mn100:6.2: tatra bho gotama, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā diṭṭhadhammābhiññāvosānapāramippattā ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānanti, tesaṃ bhavaṃ gotamo katamo’ti?
mn100:7.1: diṭṭhadhammābhiññāvosānapāramippattānaṃ ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānantānampi kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, vemattataṃ vadāmi.
mn100:7.5: santi pana bhāradvāja, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kevalaṃ saddhāmattakena diṭṭhadhammābhiññāvosānapāramippattā ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānanti.
mn100:7.7: santi bhāradvāja, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaññeva dhammaṃ abhiññāya diṭṭhadhammābhiññāvosānapāramippattā ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānanti.
mn100:7.8: tatra bhāradvāja, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaññeva dhammaṃ abhiññāya diṭṭhadhammābhiññāvosānapāramippattā ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānanti, tesāhamasmi.
mn100:8.1: tadamināpetaṃ bhāradvāja, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ: yathā ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaññeva dhammaṃ abhiññāya diṭṭhadhammābhiññāvosānapāramippattā ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānanti, tesāhamasmīti.
mn100:9.1: idha me bhāradvāja, pubbeva sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi:
mn100:9.3: nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
mn100:9.4: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyya”nti.
mn100:9.5: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, aparena samayena daharova samāno susukāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā akāmakānaṃ mātāpitunnaṃ assumukhānaṃ rudantānaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ.
mn100:9.6: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno kiṃkusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn100:9.7: “icchāmahaṃ āvuso kālāma, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye brahmacariyaṃ caritu”nti.
mn100:9.8: evaṃ vutte bhāradvāja, āḷāro kālāmo maṃ etadavoca:
mn100:9.10: tādiso ayaṃ dhammo yattha viññū puriso na cirasseva sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyā”ti.
mn100:9.11: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, nacirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇiṃ.
mn100:9.12: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, tāvatakeneva oṭṭhappahatamattena lapitalāpanamattena ñāṇavādañca vadāmi theravādañca ‘jānāmi passāmī”ti ca paṭijānāmi ahañceva aññe ca.
mn100:9.14: “na kho āḷāro kālāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ kevalaṃ saddhāmattakena ‘sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī”ti pavedeti.
mn100:9.15: addhā āḷāro kālāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ viharatī”ti.
mn100:10.1: atha khvāhaṃ bhāradvāja, yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn100:10.2: “kittāvatā no āvuso kālāma, imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī’ti pavedemī”ti.
mn100:10.3: evaṃ vutte bhāradvāja, āḷāro kālāmo ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ pavedesi.
mn100:10.5: “na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi saddhā, mayhampatthi saddhā.
mn100:10.6: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi viriyaṃ …pe…
mn100:10.10: yannūnāhaṃ yaṃ dhammaṃ āḷāro kālāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī’ti pavedeti, tassa dhammassa sacchikiriyāya padaheyya”nti.
mn100:10.11: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, na cirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn100:10.12: atha khvāhaṃ bhāradvāja, yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn100:10.13: “ettāvatā no āvuso kālāma, imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesī”ti.
mn100:10.14: ettāvatā kho ahaṃ āvuso, imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemī’ti.
mn100:10.15: ahampi kho āvuso ettāvatā imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī’ti.
mn100:10.16: lābhā no avuso, suladdhaṃ no āvuso
mn100:10.17: ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ passāma
mn100:10.18: iti, yāhaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemi, taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi.
mn100:10.19: yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi, tamahaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemi.
mn100:10.20: iti yāhaṃ dhammaṃ jānāmi, taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi. yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi, tamahaṃ dhammaṃ jānāmi.
mn100:10.21: iti yādiso ahaṃ, tādiso tuvaṃ. yādiso tuvaṃ, tādiso ahaṃ.
mn100:10.22: ehi dāni āvuso, ubho’va santā imaṃ gaṇaṃ pariharāmā’ti.
mn100:10.23: iti kho bhāradvāja, āḷāro kālāmo ācariyo me samāno attano antevāsiṃ maṃ samānaṃ attenā samasamaṃ ṭhapesi, uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesi.
mn100:10.25: “nāyaṃ dhammo nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, yāvadeva ākiñcaññāyanūpapattiyā”ti.
mn100:10.26: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, taṃ dhammaṃ analaṅkaritvā tasmā dhammā nibbijja apakkamiṃ.
mn100:11.1: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, kiṃkusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno yena uddako rāmaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā uddakaṃ rāmaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn100:11.2: “icchāmahaṃ āvuso rāma imasmiṃ dhammavinaye brahmacariyaṃ caritu”nti.
mn100:11.3: evaṃ vutte bhāradvāja, uddako rāmaputto maṃ etadavoca:
mn100:11.5: tādiso ayaṃ dhammo, yattha viññū puriso na cirasseva sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyā”ti.
mn100:11.6: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, na cirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇiṃ.
mn100:11.7: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, tāvatakeneva oṭṭhapahatamattena lapita lāpanamattena ñāṇavādañca vadāmi, theravādañca ‘jānāmi passāmī’ti ca paṭijānāmi, ahañceva aññe ca.
mn100:11.9: “na kho rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ kevalaṃ saddhāmattakena sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī”ti pavedesi,
mn100:11.10: addhā rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ vihāsī’ti.
mn100:11.11: atha khvāhaṃ bhāradvāja, yena uddako rāmaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā uddakaṃ rāmaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn100:11.12: “kittāvatā no āvuso, rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī’ti pavedesī”ti.
mn100:11.13: evaṃ vutte bhāradvāja, uddako rāmaputto nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ pavedesi.
mn100:11.15: “na kho rāmasseva ahosi saddhā, mayhampatthi saddhā.
mn100:11.20: yannūnāhaṃ yaṃ dhammaṃ rāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī’ti pavedesi. tassa dhammassa sacchikiriyāya padaheyya”nti.
mn100:11.21: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, na cirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn100:12.1: atha khvāhaṃ bhāradvāja, yena uddako rāmaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā uddakaṃ rāmaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn100:12.2: “ettāvatā no āvuso rāma imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesī”ti.
mn100:12.3: ettāvatā kho āvuso imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemī’ti.
mn100:12.4: ‘ahampi kho āvuso, ettāvatā imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī’ti.
mn100:12.5: lābhā no āvuso, suladdhaṃ no āvuso,
mn100:12.6: ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ brahmacāriṃ passāma.
mn100:12.7: iti yaṃ dhammaṃ rāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesi taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi.
mn100:12.8: yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi, taṃ dhammaṃ rāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesi.
mn100:12.9: iti yaṃ dhammaṃ rāmo abhiññāsi, taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi. yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi taṃ dhammaṃ rāmo abhiññāsi.
mn100:12.10: iti yādiso rāmo ahosi, tādiso tuvaṃ. yādiso tuvaṃ, tādiso rāmo ahosi.
mn100:12.11: ehi dāni āvuso, tuvaṃ imaṃ gaṇaṃ pariharā’ti.
mn100:12.12: iti kho bhāradvāja, uddako rāmaputto sabrahmacārī me samāno ācariyaṭṭhāne maṃ ṭhapesi, uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesi.
mn100:12.14: “nāyaṃ dhammo nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, yāvadeva nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpapattiyā”ti.
mn100:12.15: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, taṃ dhammaṃ analaṃkaritvā tasmā dhammā nibbijja apakkamiṃ.
mn100:13.1: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, kiṃkusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno magadhesu anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena uruvelā senānigamo tadavasariṃ.
mn100:13.2: tatthaddasaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ bhūmibhāgaṃ pāsādikañca vanasaṇḍaṃ nadiñca sandantiṃ setakaṃ supatitthaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ samantā ca gocaragāmaṃ.
mn100:13.4: “ramaṇīyo vata bho bhūmibhāgo, pāsādiko ca vanasaṇḍo, nadī ca sandati setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā, samantā ca gocaragāmo.
mn100:13.6: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, tattheva nisīdiṃ
mn100:14.1: apissu maṃ bhāradvāja, tisso upamāyo paṭibhaṃsu anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā:
mn100:14.2: seyyathā’pi bhāradvāja, allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ udake nikkhittaṃ,
mn100:14.6: api nu so puriso amuṃ allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ udake nikkhittaṃ uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya abhimanthento aggiṃ abhinibbatteyya tejo pātukareyyā’ti?
mn100:14.9: aduṃ hi bho gotama, allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ, tañca pana udake nikkhittaṃ.
mn100:14.10: yāvadeva ca pana so puriso kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assā’ti.
mn100:14.11: evameva kho bhāradvāja, ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kāyena ceva kāmehi avūpakaṭṭhā viharanti, yo ca nesaṃ kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho, so ca ajjhattaṃ na suppahīno hoti, na suppaṭippassaddho. opakkamikā ce’pi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti, abhabbāva te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya. no ce’pi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇa, opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti, abhabbāva te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
mn100:14.12: ayaṃ kho maṃ bhāradvāja, paṭhamā upamā paṭibhāsi anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā.
mn100:15.1: aparā’pi maṃ bhāradvāja dutiyā upamā paṭibhāsi anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā:
mn100:15.2: seyyathā’pi bhāradvāja, allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ ārakā udakā thale nikkhittaṃ.
mn100:15.6: apinu so puriso amuṃ allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ ārakā udakā thale nikkhittaṃ uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya abhimanthento aggiṃ abhinibbatteyya tejo pātukareyyā’ti?
mn100:15.9: aduṃ hi bho gotama, allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ, kiñcāpi ārakā udakā thale nikkhittaṃ
mn100:15.10: yāvadeva ca pana so puriso kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assā’ti. evameva kho bhāradvāja, ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kāyena kheā kāmehi vūpakaṭṭhā viharanti. yo ca nesaṃ kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasineho kāmamucchā kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho, so ca ajjhattaṃ na suppahīno hoti na suppaṭippassaddho opakkamikā ce’pi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti, abhabbāva te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya. no ce’pi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti, abhabbāva te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
mn100:15.11: ayaṃ kho maṃ bhāradvāja, dutiyā upamā paṭibhāsi anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā.
mn100:16.1: aparā’pi kho maṃ bhāradvāja, tatiyā upamā paṭibhāsi, anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā:
mn100:16.2: seyyathāpi bhāradvāja, sukkhaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ kolāpaṃ ārakā udakā thale nikkhittaṃ.
mn100:16.6: apinu so puriso amuṃ sukkhaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ kolāpaṃ ārakā udakā thale nikkhittaṃ uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya abhimanthento aggiṃ abhinibbatteyya, tejo pātukareyyā’ti?
mn100:16.9: aduṃ hi bho gotama, sukkhaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ kolāpaṃ, tañca pana ārakā udakā thale nikkhitta’nti.
mn100:16.10: evameva kho bhāradvāja, ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kāyena ceva cittena ca kāmehi vūpakaṭṭhā viharanti. yo ca nesaṃ kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho, so ca ajjhattaṃ suppahīno hoti suppaṭippassaddho. opakkamikā cepi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti, bhabbāva te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
mn100:16.11: ayaṃ kho maṃ bhāradvāja, tatiyā upamā paṭibhāsi anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā.
mn100:16.12: imā kho maṃ bhāradvāja, tisso upamā paṭibhaṃsu anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā.
mn100:17.2: “yannūnāhaṃ dantebhidantamādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇheyyaṃ abhinippīḷeyyaṃ abhisantāpeyya”nti.
mn100:17.3: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, dantebhidantamādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhāmi abhinippīḷemi abhisantāpemi.
mn100:17.4: tassa mayhaṃ bhāradvāja, dantebhidantamādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhato abhinippīḷayato abhisantāpayato kacchehi sedā muccanti.
mn100:17.5: seyyathāpi bhāradvāja, balavā puriso dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ sīse vā gahetvā khandhe vā gahetvā abhiniggaṇheyya abhinippīḷeyya abhisantāpeyya,
mn100:17.6: evameva kho me bhāradvāja, dantebhidantamādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhato abhinippīḷayato abhisantāpayato kacchehi sedā muccanti.
mn100:17.7: āraddhaṃ kho pana me bhāradvāja, viriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati apammuṭṭhā, sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho teneva dukkhappadhānena padhānābhitunnassa sato.
mn100:18.3: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, mukhato ca nāsato ca assāsapassāse uparundhiṃ.
mn100:18.4: tassa mayhaṃ bhāradvāja, mukhato ca nāsato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu kaṇṇasotehi vātānaṃ nikkhamantānaṃ adhimatto saddo hoti.
mn100:18.5: seyyathāpi nāma kammāragaggariyā dhamamānāya adhimatto saddo hoti
mn100:18.6: evameva kho me bhāradvāja, mukhato ca nāsato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu kaṇṇasotehi vātānaṃ nikkhamantānaṃ adhimatto saddo hoti.
mn100:18.7: āraddhaṃ kho pana me bhāradvāja, viriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati apammuṭṭhā, sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho teneva dukkhappadhānena padhānābhitunnassa sato.
mn100:19.3: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāse uparundhiṃ.

mn100:19.5: seyyathāpi bhāradvāja, balavā puriso tiṇhena sikharena muddhani abhimantheyya,
mn100:19.6: evameva kho me bhāradvāja, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu adhimattā vātā muddhani ūhananti.
mn100:19.7: āraddhaṃ kho pana me bhāradvāja, viriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati apammuṭṭhā, sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho teneva dukkhappadhānena padhānābhitunnassa sato.
mn100:20.3: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāse uparundhiṃ.

mn100:20.5: seyyathāpi bhāradvāja, balavā puriso daḷhena varattakabandhena sīse sīsaveṭhaṃ dadeyya,
mn100:20.6: evameva kho bhāradvāja, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu adhimattā sīse sīsavedanā honti.

mn100:21.3: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāse uparundhiṃ.
mn100:21.4: tassa mayhaṃ bhāradvāja, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu adhimattā vātā kucchiṃ parikantanti.
mn100:21.5: seyyathāpi bhāradvāja, dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā tiṇhena govikantanena kucchiṃ parikanteyya,
mn100:21.6: evameva kho me, bhāradvāja, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu adhimattā vātā kucchiṃ parikantanti.
mn100:21.7: āraddhaṃ kho pana me, bhāradvāja, viriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati apammuṭṭhā, sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho teneva dukkhappadhānena padhānābhitunnassa sato.
mn100:22.3: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāse uparundhiṃ.
mn100:22.4: tassa mayhaṃ bhāradvāja, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu adhimatto kāyasmiṃ ḍāho hoti.
mn100:22.5: seyyathāpi bhāradvāja, dve balavanto purisā dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuyā santāpeyya samparitāpeyya.
mn100:22.6: evameva kho me bhāradvāja, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu adhimatto kāyasmiṃ ḍāho hoti.
mn100:22.7: āraddhaṃ kho pana me bhāradvāja, viriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati apammuṭṭhā, sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho teneva dukkhappadhānena padhānābhitunnassa sato.
mn100:23.1: apissu maṃ bhāradvāja, devatā disvā evamāhaṃsu:
mn100:23.4: “na kālakato samaṇo gotamo, api ca kālaṅkarotī’ti.
mn100:23.7: arahaṃ samaṇo gotamo, vihārotveveso arahato evarūpo hotī”ti.
mn100:24.3: atha kho maṃ bhāradvāja, devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ:
mn100:24.4: “mā kho tvaṃ mārisa, sabbaso āhārūpacchedāya paṭipajji.
mn100:24.5: sace kho tvaṃ mārisa, sabbaso āhārūpacchedāya paṭipajjissasi, tassa te mayaṃ dibbaṃ ojaṃ lomakūpehi ajjhohāressāma
mn100:24.8: ‘ahañceva kho pana sabbaso ajaddhukaṃ paṭijāneyyaṃ, imā ca me devatā dibbaṃ ojaṃ lomakūpehi ajjhohāreyyuṃ, tāya cāhaṃ yāpeyyaṃ,
mn100:24.10: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, tā devatā paccācikkhāmi, halanti vadāmi.
mn100:25.2: ‘yannūnāhaṃ thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhāreyyaṃ pasataṃ pasataṃ yadi vā muggayūsaṃ yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ yadi vā kalāyayūsaṃ yadi vā hareṇukayūsa”nti.
mn100:25.3: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ pasataṃ pasataṃ yadi vā muggayūsaṃ yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ yadi vā kalāyayūsaṃ yadi vā hareṇukayūsaṃ.
mn100:25.4: tassa mayhaṃ bhāradvāja, thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhārayato pasataṃ pasataṃ yadi vā muggayūsaṃ yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ yadi vā kalāyayūsaṃ yadi vā hareṇukayūsaṃ adhimattakasimānaṃ patto kāyo hoti.
mn100:25.5: seyyathāpi nāma āsītikapabbāni vā kāḷapabbāni vā, evamevassu me aṅgapaccaṅgāni bhavanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:25.6: seyyathāpi nāma oṭṭhapadaṃ, evamevassu me ānisadaṃ hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:25.7: seyyathāpi nāma vaṭṭanāvalī, evamevassu me piṭṭhikaṇṭako unnatāvanato hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:25.8: seyyathāpi nāma jarasālāya gopānasiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti, evamevassu me phāsuliyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:25.9: seyyathāpi nāma gambhīre udapāne udakatārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti, evamevassu me akkhikūpesu akkhitārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:25.10: seyyathāpi nāma tittakā lābu āmakacchinno vātātapena samphuṭito hoti sammilāto, evamevassu me sīsacchavi samphuṭitā hoti sammilātā tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:25.11: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, udaracchaviṃ parāmasissāmī’ti piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃyeva parigaṇhāmi. ‘piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ parāmasissāmī’ti udaracchaviṃyeva parigaṇhāmi. yāvassu me bhāradvāja, udaracchavi piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ allīnā hoti tāyevappāhāratāya,
mn100:25.12: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, ‘vaccaṃ vā muttaṃ vā karissāmī’ti tattheva avakujjo papatāmi tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:25.13: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, imameva kāyaṃ assāsento pāṇinā gattāni anumajjāmi. tassa mayhaṃ bhāradvāja, pāṇinā gattāni anumajjato pūtimūlāni lomāni kāyasmā papatanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:26.1: apissu maṃ bhāradvāja, manussā disvā evamāhaṃsu: “kāḷo samaṇo gotamo”ti.
mn100:26.2: ekacce manussā evamāhaṃsu: “na kāḷo samaṇo gotamo, sāmo samaṇo gotamo”ti.
mn100:26.3: ekacce manussā evamāhaṃsu: “na kāḷo samaṇo gotamo, na’pi sāmo, maṅguracchavi samaṇo gotamo”ti.
mn100:26.4: yāvassu me bhāradvāja, tāva parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto upahato hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:27.2: “ye kho keci atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyiṃsu, etāva paramaṃ nayito bhiyyo.
mn100:27.3: ye’pi hi keci anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyissanti, etāva paramaṃ nayito bhiyyo.
mn100:27.4: ye’pi hi keci etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti, etāva paramaṃ nayito bhiyyo.
mn100:27.5: na kho panāhaṃ imāya kaṭukāya dukkarakāriyāya adhigacchāmi uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ.
mn100:27.6: siyā nu kho añño maggo bodhāyā”ti?
mn100:28.2: “abhijānāmi kho panā’haṃ pitusakkassa kammante sītāya jambucchāyāya nisinno vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharitā.
mn100:28.4: tassa mayhaṃ bhāradvāja, satānusāri viññāṇaṃ ahosi:
mn100:29.2: “kiṃ nukho ahaṃ tassa sukhassa bhāyāmi, yaṃ taṃ sukhaṃ aññatreva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehī”ti.
mn100:29.4: “na kho ahaṃ tassa sukhassa bhāyāmi, yaṃ taṃ sukhaṃ aññatreva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehī”ti.
mn100:30.2: “na kho taṃ sukaraṃ sukhaṃ adhigantuṃ evaṃ adhimattakasimānaṃ pattakāyena.
mn100:30.4: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja, oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ odanakummāsaṃ.
mn100:30.5: tena kho pana maṃ bhāradvāja, samayena pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū paccupaṭṭhitā honti,
mn100:30.6: “yaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ adhigamissati, taṃ no ārocessatī”ti.
mn100:30.7: yato kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ odanakummāsaṃ. atha me te pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū nibbijja pakkamiṃsu
mn100:31-33.1: so kho ayaṃ bhāradvāja, oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāretvā balaṃ gahetvā vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn100:34.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite aneñjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
mn100:34.2: so anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi. seyyathidaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi.
mn100:35.1: ayaṃ kho me bhāradvāja, rattiyā paṭhame yāme paṭhamā vijjā adhigatā,
mn100:35.2: avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā tamo vihato āloko uppanno yathā taṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
mn100:36-38.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
mn100:36-38.2: so dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passāmi cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate, yathākammūpage satte pajānāmi …pe…
mn100:36-38.3: ayaṃ kho me bhāradvāja, rattiyā majjhime yāme dutiyā
mn100:36-38.4: vijjā adhigatā, avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā, tamo vihato āloko uppanno, yathā taṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
mn100:39.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
mn100:39.2: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ. …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhāññāsiṃ.
mn100:39.3: ime āsavāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ. …pe… ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminīpaṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
mn100:40.1: tassa me evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha. bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha. avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha.
mn100:40.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsiṃ.
mn100:41.1: ayaṃ kho me bhāradvāja, rattiyā pacchime yāme tatiyā
mn100:41.2: vijjā adhigatā, avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā, tamo vihato, āloko uppanno, yathā taṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharatoti.
mn100:42.1: evaṃ vutte saṅgāravo māṇavo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn100:42.2: aṭṭhitavataṃ bhoto gotamassa padhānaṃ ahosi. sappurisavataṃ bhoto gotamassa padhānaṃ ahosi,
mn100:42.4: kinnu kho bho gotama, atthi devāti.
mn100:42.7: devāti. kinnu kho bho gotama, atthi devāti puṭṭho samāno, ṭhānaso metaṃ bhāradvāja, viditaṃ yadidaṃ atthi devāti vadesi?
mn100:42.8: na nu bho gotama, evaṃ sante tucchā musā hotī’ti.
mn100:42.9: atthi devā’ti bhāradvāja, puṭṭho samāno, atthi devā’ti yo vadeyya. ṭhānaso me viditāti yo vadeyya,
mn100:42.10: atha khevattha viññunā purisena ekaṃsena niṭṭhaṃ gantabbaṃ yadidaṃ
mn100:42.12: kissa pana me bhavaṃ gotamo, ādikeneva na byākāsīti.
mn100:42.13: uccena sammataṃ kho etaṃ bhāradvāja, lokasmiṃ yadidaṃ
mn100:43.1: evaṃ vutte saṅgāravo māṇavo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn100:43.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ bho gotama,
mn100:43.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintī’ti. evamevaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
mn100:43.4: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
mn100:43.5: upāsakā maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgata’nti.
